decisionSummary: The Aug 20 dev-publish v23/2.0.30 source is canonical. It is the direct forward release-identity cut from the reviewed rich miniPaint/Jinn peer line: it retains the tested scoped read-only GrainContext integration for Jinn, the full PowerBox-gated image editor, and candidate-bound metadata while making the signed package, runtime contract, and catalog name agree on Bureau Paint. It intentionally omits the Store-gallery screenshot declaration until the governed transport carries its bytes, while retaining the embedded in-app image. Main is its reviewed stable ancestor; the divergent metadata and historical publish/codex refs are old package or release lines and contain no newer runnable Paint source.

checks: fresh detached checkout at the selected source commit with the recorded spkmodule revision
make release-inputs mutation-test and make test (234 passed)
two independent commit-level candidate packages matched SHA-256 e7d6e4398713f9f62cc4d7ebec453f3bb3a050aa6b3d9da79eb17ef37c00f7fb and packageId e7d6e4398713f9f62cc4d7ebec453f3b
make verify-candidate-metadata verified the generated catalog metadata against the exact SPK
the selected source's catalog metadata, package manifest, and runtime contract all use the requested public name Bureau Paint with an empty Store-gallery declaration

the governed candidate bound that exact SPK to AppHash 69f02122328b62843f277b41613131880024dd899b81ec76be5160628619340f and release hash 860c49ce0414296b39fa29189fe4a3dd91e23edc7e5d84eaaf178e00dcf4bcd7
the shared 3-of-4 Squads authority approved the candidate; the public 32-app catalog and Chromium-rendered Bazaar card serve Bureau Paint 2.0.30 with packageId e7d6e4398713f9f62cc4d7ebec453f3b
